data.name: Omairat
data.gender_notes: Omairat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Servant of Allah, Lion of God. The name Omairat carries the meaning “Lion of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Omairat usually hope their child will grow to embody lion of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A brave and fearless servant of Allah
data.etymology: Omairat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omairat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عميرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يرجع إلى الجذر عم ر، ومعناه الجمال والصغر، ويشير إلى الفتاة الجميلة والصغيرة، ويستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية كاسم للبنات، ويعتبر من الأسماء الجميلة والمعبرة

in_urdu.name: عمیرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربي gốc کا ایک نام، جو جڑ عم ر سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا معنی ہے خوبصورت اور چھوٹی، اور یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامي ثقافت میں بہت مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: उमैरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक अरबी मूल का नाम, जो जड़ عم र से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है सुंदर और छोटी, और यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है

in_pashto.name: عمیره
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ریشې څخه یو نوم، چې د عم ر ریښې څخه اخیستل شوی، او د هغې مانا ښایسته او کم بوډه نجلۍ ده، او دا نوم د نجلۍ لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا نوم په افغان/پشتون دود کې ډیر مشهور دی

data.cultural_impact: The name "Omairat" carries a powerful symbolism in Islamic culture, representing the devotion and commitment of an individual to serve and honor Allah. The name's connection to the lion adds a sense of strength, courage, and determination, reflecting the noble qualities of a faithful servant of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of "Omairat" lies in its reminder of the servitude and devotion to Allah, as well as the inner strength and courage that allows us to fulfill our religious duties. The name functions as a constant reminder of the ultimate purpose and goal of our lives: to please Allah and seek His pleasure in all aspects of our existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lion of God" symbolizes Servant of Allah, Lion of God. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Omairat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lion of god.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Omar ibn al-Khattab was one of the earliest converts to Islam and a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad.
historical_references.context: Omar ibn al-Khattab was a key figure in early Islamic history and is considered one of the Rashidun Caliphs.

trends: used as a given name for boys
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Omar, including the variant Omairat, is used as a given name for boys in the Muslim world and beyond. It is also used in personal contexts, such as on social media, to honor the historical figure of Omar ibn al-Khattab.
